week_selection.method: candidate-specific deterministic Monday selection from previously unused BTC weeks

market_representation.auction_windows: independent 8-hour UTC perpetual-funding windows starting 00/08/16 UTC
market_representation.initial_balance: first two completed cost-resolved equal-notional events in each window
market_representation.event_clock: causal daily equal-notional clock selected from the immediately preceding completed UTC day

scenario.opportunity_limit: one resolved raid per funding window
scenario.raid: first event after initial-balance completion that trades beyond exactly one balance edge
scenario.failure: completed close returns inside the raided edge with aggressive flow toward the opposite edge
scenario.failure_target: opposite initial-balance edge, provided it was not consumed before entry
scenario.failure_stop: complete raid-to-resolution path extreme plus one 7-bp side-cost buffer
scenario.acceptance: two outside closes and positive cumulative aligned flow
scenario.acceptance_target: one initial-balance width projected beyond the raided edge, provided it was not consumed
scenario.acceptance_stop: raided edge plus one 7-bp inside buffer
scenario.entry: market bracket on first official venue trade strictly after completed resolution
scenario.expiry: end of the same funding window

execution.market_data: official Binance Vision USD-M aggregate trades converted one-for-one to TradeTick
